Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Hoodi Fork Over EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 Risks

Ethereum researcher Toni Wahrstätter said the planned Glamsterdam fork on the Hoodi testnet has been delayed after ChainSecurity identified compatibility risks in EIP-8037 and EIP-8038. The gas changes could break contracts that assume gas usage only decreases or cause failed sub-calls to behave unexpectedly. ChainSecurity has found 13 real-world cases, and developers are reviewing whether the upgrade specification needs changes. — link

Solana and Ethereum had both been under consideration before Akash made its final choice. — link

Galaxy: Bitcoin bear market ended in June, accumulation phase underway

Galaxy Research said Bitcoin’s bear market ended in June 2026 and the asset is now in an accumulation phase, with BTC closing above its 50-week moving average for five consecutive weeks. Monthly transfers from coins held for more than five years have fallen to about 34,000 BTC from 67,000 in 2024, suggesting reduced selling pressure from long-term holders. Galaxy said the bullish view would weaken if Bitcoin falls below its roughly $76,540 50-week moving average and fails to reclaim it within a month. — link

OpenZeppelin will continue to operate independently under founder Demian Brener, while its open-source smart contract libraries will remain freely available. — link
